title: Selected Radius Component
statement: Let $S$ be an exponential BFS machine state and let $\phi$ be a Boolean. The entry of the 17-component counter vector of $S$ at the index assigned to $\phi$ by the phase-radius rule equals $S.s_1$ when $\phi$ is true and $S.s$ when $\phi$ is false.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is an exponential BFS machine state
replaced:
Let $S$ be a register state and let $\phi$ be a Boolean. The component of the vector
associated to $S$ at index $2$ when $\phi$ is false, and at index $3$ when $\phi$ is
true, equals the radius field $s$ of $S$ when $\phi$ is false and the field $s1$ when
$\phi$ is true.
